newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks steady, Solidere, industrials mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banks steady, Solidere, industrials mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were steady on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday while Solidere and industrial stocks were mixed.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce and Banque Audi were unchanged at $13.75 and $19.125 respectively. The LIBX bank index held steady at 119.02.
The BLOM stock index fell 0.6 percent to 902.6 and the LISPI rose 0.37 percent to 84.75.
Solidere A shares fell to $10.25 from Tuesday's $10.375 while B shares were unchanged at $10.75. Solidere turnover rose to 129,687 shares from 45,793 with high demand on A shares.
Industrial pipemaker Eternit rose to $1.9687 from $1.875 with 10,760 shares changing hands from 2,000 a day earlier.
Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.1875 on turnover of 100 shares from Tuesday's 1,500.
There was no trade in the two other listed firms: Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 153,975 shares for a value of $1,607,030 against 99,126 shares for a value of $926,129 on Tuesday.
